part.text:
All tests pass (1291 tests across runtime-core and reactivity).

Fix: in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts:66-79`, `v-for` over a reactive array was unconditionally wrapping each item with `toReactive`. Now it captures `isShallow(source)` on the proxy before `shallowReadArray` unwraps it, and skips `toReactive` for shallowReactive arrays — so items keep their raw (non-reactive) identity, matching how `reactiveReadArray` treats shallow arrays elsewhere in reactivity.
